correctness.rationale: Prefix sums of the mechanical factor are floor(β+jα); their n distinct internal jumps give n+1 different phase cells, all realized by density and with the endpoints assigned to the right cell. For an interior jump at j<n the two changed letters are 01→10, and immediately before the jump the moving one has rank floor(jα)+1. Deleting the first k ones and appending them either erases this change or gives a strict lexicographic increase. At j=n the increase is strict even if both images are sorted: their one-counts differ; when the common prefix contains k ones the final bit changes after identical prefix deletions. Hence no nonlocal collision goes undetected by the adjacent erased cuts. Exactly min(n−1,floor(k/α)) are erased; jα=k is impossible. This includes n=1 and large k. Both mechanical one-counts occur, so Abelian complexity is 2 and equality ends at floor(k/α)+1.
